source='''def transform(grid):
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row)
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 5)})
    growth = {}
    for color in colors:
        above = sum(v == color for row in grid[:divider] for v in row)
        below = sum(v == color for row in grid[divider + 1:] for v in row)
        growth[color] = below - above
    winner = max(colors, key=lambda color: growth[color])
    return [[winner, winner], [winner, winner]]
'''
